# K = 1 for every row (the registered K of each row in the frozen registries).
# DRIVER MODE: taken from the frozen registry row for the same request.  Where one request has several modes in the
#   registries, the mode is the one of the driver path that calls the site (see basis).
# EXPECTATION RULE (fixed here, before any run):
#   F column: REPORTED_FAILURE for every point, because F has an explicit check at each of these sites (basis lists the
#             file:line and the check).  A point whose F check is not in the source would get a different expectation and
#             the basis would say so.  None needed one (see the check list in ERRATA_4 section a and in the report).
#   B column: the historical observation of this point on B, from the frozen registries, if one exists (judge class
#             written in the registry; not a guess).  If no historical observation exists, the cell is UNKNOWN.
#   A column: the same rule on the A tree (CUR rows of the frozen registries); UNKNOWN if none.
#   info=NULL: B and A use family B (linearsolve_null), F uses family B2 (linearsolve_null2).  The two fault models are
#             different (B and A discard info; F checks info).  The B/F classes are therefore NOT required to match.
#   FE on B: B has no fm_ret status (the return value of FMMGetEpsilon_* is discarded on B; R5 SITE_FACTS).  The B cell
#             for FE is UNKNOWN; the fmmbuf observations of the frozen registry are a different family and are not used.
# basis tags: [源码 file:line@commit] [历史 registry-file:line] [推断].  No BLIND status anywhere.
# status: INFLUENCED for every row (the registries and ERRATA were read before this file was written).
# UNREACHABLE_EXPECTED: rows whose seam is expected to have hit 0 BEFORE the run.  Listed here, with the reason, and checked
#   after the run.  None are listed now.  (The injection points are reached through the driver paths listed in the basis.)
